scenarioDesc.AZN_DEVAL_15: AZN/USD to 1.955 (from the live ~1.70) → −15% manat; milder FX shock on the assumed import share.
scenarioDesc.AZN_DEVAL_20: AZN/USD to 2.04 (from the live CBAR rate ~1.70) → −20% manat; cost rises on the assumed 30% imported-input share.
scenarioDesc.BRENT_TO_140: Brent climbs to $140 (from the live ~110) → energy/fertilizer input cost rises.
scenarioDesc.DROUGHT_2026: Harvest −30%: revenue + yield fall but seeds/fertilizer/labour/irrigation are already spent (costRigidity 0.8) → agro margins crushed.
scenarioDesc.DROUGHT_SEVERE_50: Extreme drought tail: harvest −50%, costs largely sunk (costRigidity 0.8).
scenarioDesc.INPUT_COST_30: Input cost +30% (FX-import / sugar / grain) → margins compress across food-processing.
scenarioDesc.IRAN_HIGH: Sanctions regime tightens — petrochem feedstock cost +20%, AZN/USD spread widens, foreign-currency import lines repriced at the higher rate. Stress-tests cogs/opex against AGRO_FX_RISK + IND_NET_MARGIN.
scenarioDesc.LOSE_TOP_CUSTOMER_20: Top-customer loss → produce less; cost fully variable (margins ~flat, absolutes fall).
scenarioDesc.OIL_DROP_30: Global crude price falls 30% — revenue compression for petrochem-tied lines, secondary impact on regional FX (manat soft-peg loosens). Stress-tests revenue side + IND_GROSS_MARGIN under price-pressure regime.
scenarioDesc.REVENUE_DROP_30: Sales volume −30% → revenue + revenue-per-ha + yield fall.
scenarioDesc.SUGAR_PRICE_DROP_20: Global sugar price −20%: margin falls faster than revenue (COGS fixed).
scenarioDesc.SUGAR_PRICE_TO_70: FAO sugar index falls to 70 (from the live ~88.5) → output-price drop compresses sugar-producer margins.

page.title: Data Import
page.description: Upload any xlsx — the AI automatically detects the data type (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, operational KPI, CAPEX, sales, land, company descriptions, holding structure, budget actuals, sales forecast) and routes to the correct adapter. No separate forms per data type — one screen for everything.
page.stackLine: Stack: AI Classifier (Anthropic) → Adapter Router → 5-Phase Import → Mandatory Reconciliation. No DB changes without a 🟢 GREEN reconciliation verdict.

adminApiKeys.title: External API keys
adminApiKeys.subtitle: Per-org keys for paid / registration-only data sources. Adapters without a key here will skip themselves gracefully — the Drift Dashboard will show api_key_missing on the affected cards. Keys are stored in Organization.settings; v1 is plain JSON (encrypted column coming in v1.1).

clearSection.title: What happens when I clear a key?
clearSection.bullet1: The corresponding adapter starts returning <mono>api_key_missing</mono> on every scheduler run.
clearSection.bullet2: No data is deleted — previously-ingested points stay in the database; they just age out / drift to STALE.
clearSection.bullet3: Re-enter the key any time to resume ingestion.
